location_note: Mumbai is an acceptable target location for relocation.
why: Lollypop is a top-tier design studio seeking a UX Designer in Mumbai, aligning with her target role and location. However, her limited UX case study portfolio makes this a stretch against agency standards.
matched: Agency/startup design experience at AT Creation
gaps: Only one fully documented UX case study
Lacks rigorous end-to-end agency process documentation for complex enterprise work
angle: Lead with her B2B UX case study (Bounceless) and her agency background at AT Creation to demonstrate foundational UX thinking.
case_study: Bounceless (2024) - B2B UX case study, as it is her only fully documented problem-to-outcome design process.
red_flags: Lollypop is a prominent design agency that typically requires a robust portfolio of multiple complex case studies, which she currently lacks.
